tools.name: search_lawyers
tools.description: Search lawyers in a German city (or around a 5-digit postcode, 10 km; around a smaller place, 25 km) by area of law and language, or by the name of a lawyer or a firm. `area` is one of the 24 Fachanwalt areas (for example 'Arbeitsrecht', 'Familienrecht', 'Miet- und Wohnungseigentumsrecht'); lawyers

tools.name: get_lawyer
tools.description: One lawyer by `id` (the 16-character id from search_lawyers): register data with the date it was verified, Fachanwalt titles, firm, contact data, website and profile links, languages, and ratings per platform with the combined score.
